sql:
WITH lr AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY year), seasons_points AS (
 SELECT 'final_standings' method,r.year,ds.driver_id,ds.points FROM driver_standings ds JOIN races r USING(race_id) JOIN lr ON lr.year=r.year AND lr.round=r.round
 UNION ALL SELECT 'sum_cumulative_standings',r.year,ds.driver_id,SUM(ds.points) FROM driver_standings ds JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year,ds.driver_id
 UNION ALL SELECT 'race_only',r.year,re.driver_id,SUM(re.points) FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year,re.driver_id
 UNION ALL SELECT 'positive_race_min',r.year,re.driver_id,MIN(re.points) FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 AND re.points>0 GROUP BY r.year,re.driver_id
), low AS (SELECT * FROM seasons_points p WHERE points>0 AND points=(SELECT MIN(x.points) FROM seasons_points x WHERE x.year=p.year AND x.method=p.method AND points>0)), ct AS (SELECT l.method,l.year,re.constructor_id,l.driver_id FROM low l JOIN races r ON r.year=l.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=l.driver_id), counts AS (SELECT method,constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) seasons FROM ct GROUP BY method,constructor_id), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY method ORDER BY seasons DESC,constructor_id) rn FROM counts) SELECT method,c.name,seasons,rn FROM ranked JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) WHERE rn<=8 ORDER BY method,rn
